subject: business-studies

moments.title: Netflix offered to Blockbuster
moments.body: Hastings reportedly offers to sell Netflix to Blockbuster for $50 million. Blockbuster declines.
moments.takeaway: Incumbents can refuse acquisitions that would later save them.

moments.title: Netflix launches streaming
moments.body: Netflix launches streaming service alongside DVD by mail, beginning the transition.
moments.takeaway: Business model transitions take years to play out.

moments.title: Blockbuster bankruptcy
moments.body: Blockbuster files for bankruptcy in September 2010.
moments.takeaway: Incumbent dominance can collapse in a decade.

now.title: Streaming wars
now.body: Netflix, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video and others compete in streaming, while content costs have escalated.
now.open_questions: Is streaming a sustainable business model at current content investment levels?

reflection: Blockbuster's late-fee revenue model created the customer pain Netflix exploited.
